digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store and create dispatch
propositions: under datacenter index lag, recover_pending's keyless branch searches for an unindexed issue, misses, and unbinds the binding, causing create_one's dedup search to also miss and create a duplicate issue

the create-gate in outbound_differ consults only get_jira_key(local_id) is None, which returns None for keyless-pending entries, so it cannot suppress the duplicate even if recover_pending leaves the binding pending
the duplicate-preventing change must gate the create in dispatch_one.create_one itself, deferring (not dropping) creation while a keyless-pending binding is younger than an index-lag grace window

recover_pending must increment search_miss_count on each negative search and unbind only when both search_miss_count >= 3 and entry age exceeds the grace window, converting silent duplicates into delayed-but-correct answers
the keyed-pending branch already performs no search and is deterministic, so it remains untouched and correct
